messages:
Eric (Recruiter): Priya Kumar (SWE IC4) — onsite candidate confirmed for Thu 2024-03-21. Panel: Jordan, Alex, Sam (TBD). Candidate requested travel stipend & vegetarian lunch. Need final interview times, room booking, accessibility, and travel reimbursement process.
Maria (People Ops): Thanks @Eric — quick Qs: what's Priya's arrival airport/time? Any mobility/access needs? Do we cover train + 1 night? I'll need receipts or we can prepay Lyft. Also please confirm pronouns so we add to calendar.
Eric (Recruiter): She's flying into JFK, arriving 09:10am, departing same day 8:40pm. No mobility needs, prefers vegetarian. Pronouns: she/her. Ticket is economy. We budgeted up to $300 for travel + meal.
Alex Chen: I can interviewer windows: 10:30–11:30 or 2:00–3:00 ET. Prefer 10:30 for heads-down.
Jordan (Hiring Manager): 9:30–11:00 works for me, can take the system design slot at 10:30.
Maria (People Ops): Perfect. I'll lock 10:30–1:00 for on-site interviews (3x 45-min blocks + 30m buffer). I'll create itinerary, send reimbursement form, and request meal preferences.
Calendar Bot: Created event 'Priya Kumar — Onsite Interviews' Thu Mar 21 10:30–13:00 ET · Location: 4th floor — Interview Suite. Invite sent to panel.
Eric (Recruiter): Sending candidate travel instructions now. @Maria can you confirm whether we prepay the Lyft from JFK or reimburse? Also need printed candidate packet & laptop access for coding exercise.
Maria (People Ops): We can prepay if travel > $250. For JFK pickup, send flight confirmation and arrival cell. I'll arrange prepay; please cc the card. For printed packet — @Alex can you bring a laptop or we have loaners at front desk?
Alex Chen: I can bring my spare laptop. Also bookmarking the interview kit: `
- intro slide (2m)
- system design prompt
- take-home code link (sandbox)`
Jordan (Hiring Manager): Can someone add a short debrief calendar after the on-site? 30m at 3:30pm prefer.
Eric (Recruiter): Scheduled debrief 3:30–4:00 ET and sent to panel.
Maria (People Ops): FYI: reimbursement form: https://go.redwood/payments/form123 (internal). We'll need receipts uploaded within 10 business days. I'll email candidate the travel stipend checklist.
Alex Chen: Heads up — candidate asked about campus parking. Is visitor parking available? If not, I'll meet them at lobby.
Maria (People Ops): Visitor parking is limited; please meet at lobby at 10:15. I'll add meeting point to itinerary.
Eric (Recruiter): Love it. Last thing — feedback rubric deadline? Let's do EOD Fri 3/22 so we can decide Monday.
Jordan (Hiring Manager): EOD Fri works.
Maria (People Ops): Noted. I'll send a reminder and include a link to the rubric in the debrief invite.
Eric (Recruiter): Thanks team :thumbsup: I'll update candidate and post final itinerary in #recruiting-updates.
